author: Polar_Express
body:
This is going to be my last map submission for a while. I call it  "The Cove" It is a 4 Team Walls Map with a unique center and play elements. Mining is done above you, not below. Take a look, I think you will all like it. Thanks a lot!

Map DL with YML included: https://www.dropbox.com/sh/8n0hq6450e8pl5v/AAA6pSt87RYa1lLoUBVVxrp4a

replies.author: Polar_Express
replies.body: Not to sound rude back, but if the map devs .do not like the map, or the map does not fit into where they are wanting to drive avicus the community never gets to play them. But to directly answer your question, I make the maps for the Avicus Community, the Avicus players, but the Map dev's feed back is the first stop along the way to play-ability and actually getting the maps on the server. A map that the community loves, but the Map makers feel it is not a good fit for the network never gets played - and the number one reason to make a map, is to get it played :).
